title: Update new session RMap expiration in changeSessionId

timeline.message:
Update new session RMap expiration in changeSessionId

Signed-off-by: Chris Eager <christian@turo.com>
timeline.author: Chris Eager

timeline.body:
We’re almost duplicating `updateExpiration()` here, with two key differences:
- we’re copying the existing TTls, rather than setting to the maximum
- we’re using a batch, so it will be faster

However, I think we’d be OK to just call `updateExpiration()`.
Since the plan is to deprecate `RedissonSessionRepository`, this fix isn’t needed.
